letters.evidence: A (x~1092-1192, y~375-450): top horizontal, right vertical, bottom horizontal; bottom stroke stops short of the vertical at x~1090, so the box looks open on the left. C shows the same box (x~960-1040) with top/right/bottom strokes; there is a vertical just to its left in C (x~945), so in C it could read as closed (ם). The top-left corner is damaged by a corrosion hole in A and C. B is too wrinkled here to judge.
A: thick vertical at x~1090 running from ~y382 to ~490, i.e. below the baseline (could be ן). C: vertical at x~945. Its top is lost in the corrosion hole. A thin crack runs close to it.

A: a thinner, shorter vertical at x~1065 (y~350-450). C: vertical at x~918. Only ~25 px from pos 2, so it may be a crack or part of a letter destroyed by the hole above it. Low confidence that this is a separate letter.

A (x~868-1000): a thick roof, curved or peaked, running from x~868 up to ~950 and across to 1000; a right leg at x~1000 (y~360-460); a second leg slanting just inside the right leg (x~980 to 960). No clear separate left leg; the left end of the roof curves down. C (x~712-840): an inverted-V roof that peaks at ~796, with its left end running down. D: a curved roof with a right vertical. Whether the inner leg is detached (ה) or joined (ח) cannot be decided.

A (x~725-830): a long vertical at x~725 (y~323-453) and a thick diagonal from upper right (813,353) down-left toward the foot of the vertical (750,427). The diagonal may have a double edge. C (x~560-660): a vertical plus two parallel diagonals that descend from upper right to lower left toward the vertical. The shape is unusual. The same vertical-plus-diagonals form occurs in P56 pos 3.

A (x~640-715): a diagonal descending from upper right (710,270) to lower left (650,370), with a short thick stroke at its top and a faint top bar. C (x~430-535, y~325-395): a clear top horizontal joined at its right end to a down-left diagonal, a slanted '7'-shape. ר/ד with a slanted leg; whether the corner is round or square cannot be judged.

A (x~500-613): roof at y~255-260, right leg at x~600 curving at the top, left leg at x~540 starting slightly below the roof (possible small gap, which would make it ה). B (x~445-507): roof and two legs; the left leg appears to touch the roof. C (x~365-420): roof and two legs, touching. B and C favour ח; A leaves ה possible.

A (x~380-500): tall left vertical with a hook at its top; base; right vertical; a short stroke hanging from the top inside the box (x~460). B (x~297-402): left vertical, base, right vertical, and a small inner L-stroke at top right that comes down and turns right to meet the right vertical, which is the curled right arm of a tet. The top-left is open in B. C (x~225-315): the same box, with the top horizontal only on the right half. D: a box with a dark inner stroke at top. The top-left opening and the inner hook favour ט.

A: a small round bump at x~315-330, y~230-260, right at the crack or strip edge. B (x~210-235, y~260-295) and C (x~160-200) show a small hook or loop high in the line just left of pos 8. It may be a small letter (י) or damage. Left of this, A shows only vertical crack and strip-edge features (x~120-160, 240).

P41.greek_or_numerals: None identified with confidence. The pos 5 form (vertical plus parallel diagonals) is unusual and might be a non-Hebrew sign, but I read it as a letter.
P41.image_quality: A (electrotype) was the most useful for overall letter shapes and for the right half. C was clearest for the left half (pos 5-8) and for counting the two verticals at pos 2-3. B was clear only for pos 7-9; its right half is badly wrinkled. D was low contrast and confirmed only the box at pos 8 and the roof at pos 4.
P41.notes: The line slopes in A: y~260 at the left and ~380 at the right. A corrosion hole sits above pos 1-3 (A x~1060-1130). Cracks cross pos 2-4. Word division is uncertain. The only gap that looks like a possible space is between pos 6 and pos 7 (A x~613-640), and it is small. Another gap of ~65 px lies between pos 3 and pos 4 but may be damage. C and B are offset relative to A (by about +180 and +100 px at the left respectively). I do not recognise the text.

letters.evidence: A only: at the extreme right edge (x~1190-1275, y~240-330) a stroke runs down (slightly slanting right) and turns into a base that runs right to the strip edge, an L-shape. The rest of the letter may lie beyond the strip edge. B's right strip is too faint.

A (x~1090-1155, y~230-360): a roof; a left leg that starts slightly above the roof line; a right leg; at the bottom of the left leg a short horizontal stroke running left (x~1050-1090, y~350), which could be a tav foot. That foot might instead belong to damage or to the line below. B: not clearly visible.

A (x~910-1040): a vertical at x~917 (y~173-307) with two roughly parallel diagonals rising to the upper right from its middle (to ~983,181) and lower part (to ~1030,225). A further diagonal descends down-left from the vertical's top (911,167 to 869,221). B (x~856-970): a vertical and a diagonal descending from upper right toward its lower part, consistent with A. The same form appears in P41 pos 5. I cannot tell whether the down-left stroke at its top belongs to this letter.

A (x~810-850): a thick vertical at x~825-838 (y~163-277), starting higher than the neighbouring letters, with a faint curved stroke running down-left from its top (a roof?). B: a vertical at x~770 (y~210-345), consistent.
A (x~740-780, y~165-230): faint short strokes, one near-vertical at ~750-765. B (x~680-720): a diagonal. Not readable.

A x~300-700: vertical cracks or a strip joint (x~600-690), a large blister or flake (x~340-500) and a horizontal crack along the line. B shows a dark hole here. The number of letters cannot be counted.

A (x~185-280, y~190-280): a thick diagonal from upper left (185,190) to lower right (240,280), with a thinner stroke joining from the upper right (280,200 to 255,240). A horizontal crack runs through it. B: indistinct in this area.

P56.greek_or_numerals: None certain. The pos 3 shape could be read as a Κ-like sign, but I treat it as a letter.
P56.image_quality: A was the only usable view; the right half (x>800) is legible. B is very faint and wrinkled and only confirms the verticals at pos 3-4. There is no C or D.
P56.notes: The line slopes: y~230 at the left, ~285 at the right. The left half is heavily damaged (blister, cracks, a hole in B). Spaces: a possible space before the damaged stretch only. I do not recognise the text.

letters.evidence: A (x~1263-1355): a vertical at x~1272 (y~165-302), a hooked stroke at its top right, a second slanting stroke (x~1290-1305, y~235-320) and a diagonal at the far right (1315-1352). Not resolvable. B and D: not readable here.
A: a dark rounded blob at x~1205-1240, y~172-220, high in the line. It could be a small letter (י) or a corrosion pit.

A (x~1005-1213): a long roof that curves up from x~1010 to a peak at ~1120 and down to the right; right vertical at x~1180 (y~192-297); base at y~288 from ~1072 to 1197, extending slightly right of the vertical. Open on the left. The roof runs further left than the base. D (right strip): a box-like form with a long base, consistent. B: not readable.
A: a diagonal stroke low in the line (x~924-1016, y~313-284), rising to the right, next to a vertical crack at x~1012-1022. It may be a letter base, damage, or part of a neighbour.

A (x~774-907): left vertical (y~200-330) with a hook at top curving to the upper left; base (803-903); right vertical (x~899) whose top turns left as a short horizontal (853-900, y~213). The top is open between x~800 and 850. This matches the tet form in P41 pos 8 and P92 pos 5-6.

A (x~640-780): a very tall vertical at x~640-665 starting well above the line (y~90, possibly joining a stroke of the line above) and running down to y~320, plus a base running right to x~770. B: a dark crack runs at x~600-660 here, so part of this vertical may be the crack. I read it as a letter with an ascender, but this is weak.

A (x~522-576): an inverted-V or roof with two legs: one runs from (548,195) down to (530,295) and the other from (563,212) to (576,307). B (x~442-537): a rounded arch with a long right leg and an inner diagonal. D: a rounded arch shape.

A (x~388-480): a rounded arch roof; a thick right leg at x~455-480 (y~200-340); a dark curved inner stroke at x~425-442. B (x~325-420): a matching rounded arch with an inner stroke near its right leg. D: a rounded arch. The inner stroke could make this ה or מ.
A: a slightly slanted vertical at x~334-355 (y~190-280) and a short vertical at x~367-380. B: faint verticals at x~205 and ~290. These may be one or two narrow letters.
A x~110-330: faint slanting strokes (x~230-330) and damage. Not countable.

P63.image_quality: A was best overall. B (left strip) shows the arch shapes of pos 7-8 clearly but its right strip is washed out by wrinkles. D is low contrast and shows only the arch bumps on the left and a box on the right.
P63.notes: The line is roughly level at y~220. Letters on the right are large (pos 3 ~200 px wide). A vertical crack at A x~1015 and a crack or joint in B at x~600-660 complicate pos 4 and pos 6. The B and D strips are offset from A by roughly -60 px. Spacing: no clear word spaces. I do not recognise the text.

letters.evidence: A: faint dark strokes at x~1105-1130, y~187-255, at the strip's right edge. Not readable.

A (x~928-1066): a U-shaped bowl (left arm from 924,210 down to 966,262, bottom to ~1040,262, right arm up to 1066,195). A tall vertical at x~990 rises from inside the bowl to y~110, well above the line. A short descender below the bowl's left part (x~950, y~270-310). It reads as a three-armed ש with an over-tall middle arm, or as ל plus a separate bowl-shaped letter. B (x~810-870): a faint curved stroke with a dark spot, not decisive.
A (x~866-897): a vertical (y~195-302) running below the baseline, with a diagonal head at its top (866-908, y~150-187). B: indistinct.

A (x~735-848): left vertical, base at y~272, right vertical with a small loop or curl at its top turning inward. B (x~620-750): the same form, with a small knob or loop at the top right and a base. Both images agree.

A (x~590-702): base (y~275); right vertical whose top curls inward to the left; the left arm rises and flares out to the upper left (to ~545,150). B (x~470-590): a clear left vertical, base, and right vertical with a round loop at the top. A and B agree on ט. The flaring stroke at upper left in A may belong to pos 6.
A: a short vertical at x~515-525 (y~165-226). B: vertical at x~610-635 (if that is not part of pos 4). Weak.

A: a long diagonal from (495,168) down-left to (453,303), descending below the baseline. B (x~340-400): a slanted left leg descending long and down-left, which B attaches to a roof (see pos 9). The two images may divide the strokes differently.
A (x~360-438): a vertical at x~413-427 (y~153-227) continuing as a diagonal foot down-left to (360,270); a separate diagonal (380-438, y~226-257).

A (x~300-365): a vertical at x~320 (y~160-227) with a diagonal joining its top from the upper right (363,90 to 330,153) and a short stroke running right at mid-height. B (x~225-300): a vertical plus a long diagonal descending to the lower left, ע/צ-like. Not secure.

A (x~190-295): a roof at y~75-85 (very high, possibly in the line above), left vertical at x~190-205 running continuously from y~75 to 273, right vertical at x~265 (y~100-200), another leg at x~295 (y~165-273), and a crossbar at the left (145-185, y~180). B (x~340-480): a roof with a right leg curving down, a long left leg slanting down-left, and an inner vertical. Because the strokes span two line heights, this may combine an upper-line letter with a target-line letter. Uncertain.

P92.greek_or_numerals: None certain. The pos 10 cluster has a Π-like appearance (roof plus two legs) and pos 9 a Κ-like appearance, but I read them as Hebrew ח and ע/צ with low confidence.
P92.image_quality: A was best and the middle (the two tets) is very clear. B is clear for the two tets and the roofed letter to their left but washed out on the right.
P92.notes: The line is roughly level at y~230-255. The right end (x>900) and left end (x<470) are confused by strokes from adjacent lines (tall verticals at x~990 and x~190 run up toward the line above). B is offset from A by about -100 to -110 px. No clear word spaces. I do not recognise the text.
